content: Music Information Retrieval (MIR) libraries for arrangement intelligence: librosa (Python, 0.11.0, MIT) is the canonical foundation. librosa.segment module provides: recurrence_matrix (self-similarity matrices for repetition detection), cross_similarity (compare sections/regions), agglomerative (bottom-up temporal segmentation = section detection via feature clustering), subsegment (sub-divide existing segmentation), path_enhance (multi-angle SSM path enhancement), recurrence_to_lag / lag_to_recurrence. librosa also provides feature extraction (MFCC, chroma, spectral contrast, RMS energy), onset/beat/tempo detection, and effects. MSAF (Music Structure Analysis Framework, CPJKU) and madmom/essentia are companion tools for beat-tracking and structural segmentation. For bw-brain: section detection and repetition report can be implemented by porting librosa.segment concepts to TypeScript (or shelling to Python); energy curve = RMS over time; motif signatures from chroma+pitch-class profiles + rhythm quantization.
